feeds.title: The Anarchist Library
feeds.description: The Anarchist Library is an archive focusing on anarchism and anarchist texts. Within the scope of our use of the term 'anarchism', we have been quite broad, but broad does not mean infinite and basically shrinks down to a set of ideas against the State and capital. This immediately rules out the so-called 'anarcho-capitalism', 'anarcho-nationalism' and similar crap.

feeds.title: It's Going Down
feeds.description: It's Going Down is a digital community center for anarchist, anti-fascist, autonomous anti-capitalist, and anti-colonial movements across so-called North America. Our mission is to provide a resilient platform to publicize and promote revolutionary theory and action.

feeds.title: anarchistnews.org
feeds.description: Anarchist News is a grassroots news aggregator and blog that curates anarchist perspectives—featuring commentary, obituaries, movement reports, resistance analysis, and interviews with anarchist prisoners and activists around the world

feeds.title: The Institute for Anarchist Studies
feeds.description: The Institute for Anarchist Studies (IAS), established in 1996 to support the development of anarchism, is a grant-giving organization for radical writers and translators worldwide.

feeds.title: Agency
feeds.description: Agency promotes contemporary anarchist perspectives and practices through commentary, media relations, and educational campaigns. Our mission is to:Engage the public and the mainstream media about anarchist ideas, practices, and action.

feeds.title: The AK Press Blog
feeds.description: AK Press is a worker-run collective that publishes and distributes radical books, visual and audio media, and other mind-altering material. We post interviews, reviews, reports, and events from AK authors, excerpts, and books; Along with news and anarchist publishers, booksellers, translations, & much more.

feeds.title: Slackbastard
feeds.description: Anarchy and apathy battle it out on @ndy's blog. Andy is an insouciant anarchist.

feeds.title: Anarchist Studies
feeds.description: Anarchist Studies is an international peer-reviewed inter- and multi-disciplinary journal of anarchism research that has been publishing novel, refreshing and provocative arguments for over twenty years. Shaped by the scholarship of contributors rather than editorial commitments the journal publishes research into the history, culture, theory and practice of anarchism.

feeds.title: Black Rose/Rosa Negra Anarchist Federation Blog
feeds.description: Black Rose Anarchist Federation / Federación Anarquista Rosa Negra (BRRN) is a political organization founded in 2014 which shares a common set of politics and a shared strategic vision of building popular power in our workplaces, neighborhoods, and schools toward the goal of libertarian socialism.

feeds.title: Act For Freedom Now!
feeds.description: These are tough times. Disgusted by imposed social behaviour and the models it reproduces, against every form of authority and exploitation, we aim at the destruction of this rotten system, whether it's in 'crisis' or is 'prospering'.

feeds.title: The Libertarian Labyrinth
feeds.description: An archive of anarchistic histories and possibilities; writings by anarchists, socialists, feminists and dreamers! The Libertarian Labyrinth is a collection of digital archives and blogs dedicated to the radical history, with an emphasis on the history of the anarchist movement.

feeds.title: Anarchist Black Cross Federation
feeds.description: Since the beginning of the Twentieth Century, the Anarchist Black Cross (ABC), has been on the frontline in supporting those imprisoned for struggling for freedom and liberty. Until recently, the history of the ABC movement has been lost to the pages of time. The present generation of ABC collectives were left rootless with little known information about this organization. Now, specific questions regarding our origin can now be put to rest, as we have begun to rediscover our roots.

feeds.title: Anarchist Communist Group
feeds.description: We are a revolutionary anarchist communist organisation made up of local groups and individuals who seek a complete transformation of society, and the creation of anarchist communism. This will mean the working class overthrowing capitalism, abolishing the State, getting rid of exploitation, hierarchies, and oppressions, and halting the destruction of the environment.

feeds.title: Red and Black Notes
feeds.description: Red and Black Notes is an attempt at offering an anarchist communist perspective on current issues and events. Anarchism is a political tradition that fights for a self-managed, socialist and stateless society, in which all contribute freely according to ability, and through which all have full access to the material basis for pursuing their individual and collective fulfillment.

feeds.title: Montréal Counter-information
feeds.description: Montreal Counter-info aspires to provide a space for anarchists in Montreal to diffuse their ideas and actions across overlapping networks and tendencies, outside the realm of leftist or corporate media projects. We want to encourage consistent reflection, critique, and engagement with the projects of revolt and struggle happening in this city. We want this project to contribute to clarifying ideas, sharpening practices, finding common points of departure, and exploring differences in projects and initiatives.

feeds.title: Robert Graham's Anarchism Weblog
feeds.description: I'm Robert Graham. This blog is intended to provide additional commentary and selections to accompany my anthology of anarchist writings, Anarchism: A Documentary History of Libertarian Ideas.

feeds.title: Puget Sound Anarchists
feeds.description: Puget Sound Anarchists aspires to provide a space for anarchists and anti-authoritarians in the Pacific Northwest to share ideas, reflections, and critiques in order to support struggles and revolts against all forms of domination. Our goal is to contribute to the proliferation of anti-authoritarian ideas and practices on the street and in movements more broadly.

feeds.title: Mutually Said: Poets Vegan Anarchist Pacifist
feeds.description: A blog shared between poets John Kinsella and Tracy Ryan: vegan, anarchist, pacifist, and feminist.

feeds.title: NYC Anarchist Black Cross
feeds.description: NYC Anarchist Black Cross is a collective focused on supporting US-held political prisoners and prisoners of war and opposing state repression against revolutionary social justice movements. We are a support group of the Anarchist Black Cross Federation.

feeds.title: Neighborhood Anarchist Collective
feeds.description: The Neighborhood Anarchist Collective's News section highlights local radical organizing—spotlighting mutual aid events like Share Fairs, tactical tools for community resilience, action reports, and reflections on repression—all rooted in direct solidarity and anarchist praxis

feeds.title: Anarchist Writers
feeds.description: Anarchism.pageabode.com hosts 'Anarchist Writers'—a collective space offering sharp, originary anarchist essays, book reviews, interview reports, and critical commentary from the pages of Black Flag and emerging voices in anarchist thought

feeds.title: Everyday Anarchism
feeds.description: How does anarchist philosophy apply to our everyday lives? Every other week, we'll discuss why a piece of your life or culture is all about Mutual Aid. Power exists because the people with less power allow it to exist. But we spend a lot of time telling ourselves that's not true. If we can learn that we -- each one of us -- is actually in charge, that our decisions matter, and that we in fact have a decision to make, then everything will work better.

feeds.title: Three Way Fight
feeds.description: Three Way Fight is a blog that promotes revolutionary anti-fascist analysis, strategy, and activism. Unlike liberal anti-fascists, we believe that 'defending democracy' is an illusion, as long as that 'democracy' is based on a socio-economic order that exploits and oppresses human beings. Three Way Fight brought together anarchist and independent Marxist perspectives and sought to promote inclusive discussion and debate among revolutionary leftists.

feeds.title: Anarchist Book Fair Blog
feeds.description: The NYC Anarchist Book Fair was founded in 2007. It brings around two thousand anarchists, anarchy supporters, and curious together in New York City every year since its foundation. The book fair and related events offer a space for the anarchist community, bringing together anarchx-feminists, activists, scholars, workers, immigrants, queers, trans, artists and multi- racial individuals. It also offers an opportunity for the curious to learn about anarchism tradition, philosophy, praxis and the anti-capitalist struggle.

feeds.title: Outside the Circle by Cindy Milstein
feeds.description: Cindy Milstein is the author of Anarchism and Its Aspirations, the picture-essay collaborative book with Erik Ruin titled Paths toward Utopia. Cindy has been overly engaged in numerous collective projects aimed at creating autonomous spaces of resistance, reconstruction, and education, including currently, the Montreal Anarchist Bookfair, and the Institute for Advanced Troublemaking and its Anarchist Summer School.

feeds.title: Glasgow Anarchist Federation
feeds.description: The Anarchist Federation was founded as the Anarchist Communist Federation in March of 1986. We describe ourselves as anarchist communists and revolutionary class struggle anarchists and operate as a membership organisation.

feeds.title: The Relationship Anarchist Blog
feeds.description: The Relationship Anarchist blog delivers thought-provoking, anarchism-rooted insights—offering essays and critiques that challenge romantic hierarchies, redefine commitment, and explore relationships as intentional, egalitarian, and radically autonomous bonds

feeds.title: Elizabeth Zagroba
feeds.description: Elizabeth Zagroba writes candid and insightful reflections on software testing—especially exploratory testing, intentional testing strategy, and quality leadership—infused with the clarity and curiosity of a seasoned QA practitioner.

feeds.title: debate me, bruh
feeds.description: Debate Me Bruh is a substack dedicated to developing fruitful discourses on the philosophy of anarchism. Get in-depth answers to questions on an array of topics on Anarchy, statism, and awkward questions. Read the newest articles here.

feeds.title: Enough 14
feeds.description: We are a group of free anarchists who report about political struggles around the world. Most of our reports are published in English, and some are also in German. We work together with several other media collectives. We also travel a lot to report from the ground in other territories.

feeds.title: Anarcho Blogs
feeds.description: Articles on anarchism, anarchist studies, conferences, and more by James Bush.
